research_question: Do task-disjoint training transitions provide sufficiently close semantic prototypes for a retrieval-grounded successor-action world model to outperform v6 on covered events?

retrieval.support_calibration: per-fold per-horizon 25th percentile of training leave-one-trajectory-out top-1 cosine similarity

decision_rule: Only a passing support gate authorizes retraining v6 to expose full probabilities and testing a conservative similarity-gated residual mixture.

literature_map.paper: R-WoM: Retrieval-augmented World Model for Computer-use Agents
literature_map.repo_hypothesis: Ground long-horizon forecasts in retrieved observed transitions instead of unconstrained latent generation.
